entities.summary: Prince Lev Mikhailovich Yashvil, also known as Levan Mikheilis dze Iashvili was a Georgian nobleman and a general of the Imperial Russian Army. Yashvil took part in a number of significant military campaigns, including during the French invasion of Russia, the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792) and the Kościuszko Uprising.
